title: Acquire a nonselective observable reset from noisy control contrasts
statement: Under full controlled Hankel rank <=2 and a measured nonzero preparation gap, finite count contrasts bound the slope of a positive private control mixture. epsilon=min(1,(actual fitted residual+2w)/g_lower^2) bounds all future visible transcript-event differences.

assumptions: all legal adaptive histories included in the rank promise
controller word/readout hidden and common public completion time
costs: sample scaling O(epsilon^-2 g0^-4 log(M/alpha)) under a fixed gap
actual dyadic residual and fresh bits charged
contract.units: TV=sup event probability difference; counts, actions, bits and elapsed time
contract.obstruction: Acquires a new reference preparation S(rho0), not the original rho0; same-data conventional contrast controller ties.

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
